superadmin_firebase.title: Push Notifications (FCM)
superadmin_firebase.subtitle: One Firebase project serves the whole platform. Waiter apps receive notifications; delivery is routed per restaurant automatically.

superadmin_firebase.step_2_desc: Click ⚙️ Project Settings and navigate to the Service accounts tab.
superadmin_firebase.step_3_desc: Click Generate new private key to download your Service Account JSON file.
superadmin_firebase.step_4_desc: Upload the JSON file into the field on the left and click Save.

superadmin_google.step_3_desc: Scroll down to Your apps, click Add app (</> Web), enter a nickname, and click Register app.
superadmin_google.step_4_desc: Firebase will display the SDK config object. Copy the values into the fields on the left and save.

superadmin_google.step_5_desc: Here in this admin dashboard website, go to Platform Settings → Push Notifications and upload your downloaded Service Account JSON file.
